headline: NHPC Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - NHPC Limited has informed the Exchange that MCA has fixed 28.09.2026 as hearing date in the matter of scheme of amalgamation between JPCL and NHPC Limited. The other details are given in the attached letter.
